description: Bitcoin: Get transaction history for an address, newest first: up to `max_txs` (50 by default and at most), mempool transactions first and confirmed ones filling the rest. To continue, pass the last returned txid as `after_txid`, or request `GET /api/address/{address}/txs/chain/{after_txid}` for confirmed history.

address.description: Bitcoin address, or the hex public key of a P2PK output.

after_txid.description:
Continue after this transaction, a mempool or a confirmed one: the older ones (a confirmed
cursor skips the mempool). One that is neither answers 422.

max_txs.description: Transactions to return, at most 50 (the default); larger values return 50.

name: get_address_txs
title: Address transactions
